Q4 Budget Review

Headcount frozen until the Northstar launch ships. Marketing spend capped at the Q3 baseline. Open question: should the Riverside contract renew at the higher tier?

name: marathon-training-plan.md
content:
Marathon Training Plan

Week 1: easy 5k Monday, intervals Wednesday, long run 16k Sunday. Goal pace 5:10/km. Taper begins three weeks out. Race day breakfast: oats and a banana.

name: vendor-shortlist.md
content:
Vendor Shortlist

Stellar Sound: best throughput, pricing unclear. Studio Northstar: SOC2 done, premium tier only. Recommend a pilot with Stellar Sound before committing to an annual contract.
